svg.title: Three operations leave a parity-dependent phase
svg.desc: Coherent basis-state tracking for CX(a to b), Rz(theta) on b, then CX(a to b), in |ab> basis order. The target stores a XOR b during the middle rotation; final basis bits are restored. The net phases are the RZZ(theta) diagonal entries.
svg.text: Three operations leave a parity-dependent phase
Reversible parity computation on every basis component
Input → after CX Phase angle(rad) Final bits
Input → after CX Phase angle(rad) Final bits
Input → after CX Phase angle(rad) Final bits
Input → after CX Phase angle(rad) Final bits
Basis bits are restored; relative phases remain
